title: T01a — Decision: remote inference endpoint identity, permitted data and behaviour when unavailable
goal: Decision: remote inference endpoint identity, permitted data and behaviour when unavailable.
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
acceptance: Decision: remote inference endpoint identity, permitted data and behaviour when unavailable
validation: Directed regressions or recorded evidence for this slice; final required CI
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects

effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T01a of the step "Inference host trust and privacy contract". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1.5 hours agent + 0.25 hours owner; agent writes the decision record; the owner agrees it. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history. Authoring decision record docs/decisions/remote-inference.md completed 2026-11-12 in 0.5 h agent (stated); 0.25 h owner remains for agreement. Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (0.5 h); the baseline stays for calibration.
